project.name: Cassandra + OpenSearch :: CLI
project.description:
bin/* and the JMX client behind `cassandra-opensearch status|stop|decommission`.
This jar ships in lib/boot, which is the JVM's -cp and therefore visible to both isolated ClassLoaders through their parent. It has no dependencies for that reason - not even an argument-parsing library. Four subcommands and three options do not justify putting another jar in front of Cassandra and OpenSearch.
